mapper.sql: SELECT CONCAT('m-', a.id) entry_key, 'MAIN' kind, a.name name, a.id activity_id, a.name activity_name, NULL channel_id, l.id link_id, l.full_short_url, l.origin_url origin, l.valid_date, (a.main_enabled = 1) on_flag, (l.id IS NOT NULL AND l.enable_status = 0 AND (l.valid_date IS NULL OR l.valid_date > #{q.now})) main_ready, (a.main_enabled = 1 AND a.status = 1 AND a.end_time > #{q.now} AND l.id IS NOT NULL AND l.enable_status = 0 AND (l.valid_date IS NULL OR l.valid_date > #{q.now})) effective_flag, a.status activity_status, a.start_time, a.end_time, 'direct' source, a.id sort_id FROM campaign_activity a LEFT JOIN link l ON l.id = a.main_link_id AND l.merchant_id = a.merchant_id AND l.del_time = 0 AND l.del_flag = 0 WHERE a.merchant_id = #{q.merchantId} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('c-', ch.id), 'CHANNEL', ch.name, a.id, a.name, ch.id, l.id, l.full_short_url, l.origin_url, l.valid_date, (ch.status = 1), (a.main_enabled = 1 AND l.id IS NOT NULL AND l.enable_status = 0 AND (l.valid_date IS NULL OR l.valid_date > #{q.now})), (ch.status = 1 AND a.main_enabled = 1 AND a.status = 1 AND a.end_time > #{q.now} AND l.id IS NOT NULL AND l.enable_status = 0 AND (l.valid_date IS NULL OR l.valid_date > #{q.now})), a.status, a.start_time, a.end_time, ch.channel_code, ch.id FROM campaign_channel ch JOIN campaign_activity a ON a.id = ch.activity_id AND a.merchant_id = #{q.merchantId} LEFT JOIN link l ON l.id = a.main_link_id AND l.merchant_id = a.merchant_id AND l.del_time = 0 AND l.del_flag = 0 WHERE ch.merchant_id = #{q.merchantId} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('p-', l.id), 'PLAIN', COALESCE(l.name, '普通短链'), a.id, a.name, NULL, l.id, l.full_short_url, l.origin_url, l.valid_date, (l.enable_status = 0), 1, (l.enable_status = 0 AND (l.valid_date IS NULL OR l.valid_date > #{q.now})), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, l.id FROM link l LEFT JOIN campaign_activity a ON a.id = l.activity_id AND a.merchant_id = l.merchant_id WHERE l.merchant_id = #{q.merchantId} AND l.del_time = 0 AND l.del_flag = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_activity m WHERE m.merchant_id = #{q.merchantId} AND m.main_link_id = l.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_channel c WHERE c.merchant_id = #{q.merchantId} AND c.link_id = l.id)

where.if: AND (LOWER(r.name) LIKE #{q.word} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(r.activity_name) LIKE #{q.word} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(r.full_short_url) LIKE #{q.word} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM () r ORDER BY r.sort_id DESC, r.entry_key ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN effective_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) enabled FROM () r

SELECT s.activity_id, s.activity_name, SUM(s.visits) visits FROM ( SELECT l.id, COALESCE(m.id, b.id, a.id) activity_id, COALESCE(m.name, b.name, a.name, '未归属活动') activity_name, COUNT(DISTINCT logs.visitor_id) visits FROM link l LEFT JOIN campaign_activity m ON m.main_link_id = l.id AND m.merchant_id = l.merchant_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_id, MIN(activity_id) activity_id FROM campaign_channel WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY link_id) ch ON ch.link_id = l.id AND m.id IS NULL LEFT JOIN campaign_activity b ON b.id = ch.activity_id AND b.merchant_id = l.merchant_id LEFT JOIN campaign_activity a ON a.id = l.activity_id AND a.merchant_id = l.merchant_id LEFT JOIN link_access_log logs ON logs.link_id = l.id AND logs.visitor_id != 'anonymous' WHERE l.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND l.del_time = 0 AND l.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY l.id, COALESCE(m.id, b.id, a.id), COALESCE(m.name, b.name, a.name, '未归属活动') ) s GROUP BY s.activity_id, s.activity_name ORDER BY visits DESC, s.activity_id DESC

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT logs.visitor_id) visits FROM link l LEFT JOIN link_access_log logs ON logs.link_id = l.id AND logs.visitor_id != 'anonymous' WHERE l.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND l.del_time = 0 AND l.del_flag = 0 AND l.id IN #{id} GROUP BY l.id

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.status, a.warmup_start_time, a.start_time, a.end_time, ca.quantity, ca.claimed_count claimed FROM campaign_activity a LEFT JOIN campaign_offer cc ON cc.activity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN offer_inventory ca ON ca.id = cc.inventory_id AND ca.merchant_id = a.merchant_id WHERE a.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.status = 1 AND a.start_time <= #{now} AND a.end_time > #{now} THEN 0 WHEN a.status = 1 AND a.start_time > #{now} THEN 1 WHEN a.status = 0 THEN 2 WHEN a.status = 5 THEN 3 ELSE 9 END, a.id DESC LIMIT 1
